# agg_advisor_lead_event_stream

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.agg_advisor_lead_event_stream` · dbt area: `growth`

Event stream of advisor lead lifecycle milestones, for use by tools such as Haus or Eppo to ingest events. Each row is one advisor lead - event combination, with a timestamp of when it occured. Sourced from Hubspot and the Portal database

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_lead_event_key` | A surrogate key of the advisor_lead_id and event_name >> SOURCE - Created by the data team data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_lead_id` | The unique identifier for the advisor lead (same as their contact ID in Hubspot) >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `advisor_id` | The unique identifier for the advisor (same as their user ID in Portal) >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `event_name` | A label for the type of event, such as Applied or Qualified or Activated >> SOURCE - Hubspot / Portal |
| `event_at` | A timestamp for when the event occured. For dates, they are translated to timestamps at 23:59:59 >> SOURCE - Hubspot / Portal |
